career.validFromHint: [DE] The previous record is closed the day before this date.

validation.validFromBeforeHire: [DE] The date cannot be before the hire date ({{date}}).

payments.noAccess: [DE] You are not allowed to view this employee's payment information.

salary.dialogDescription: [DE] A new salary becomes the current one from its effective date; earlier records stay in the history.

bank.title: [DE] Bank accounts
